# Haonuo Hydraulic Oil Press — hydoilpress.com

> Shandong Haonuo Machinery Equipment Group Co., Ltd. manufactures hydraulic oil press machines (325–620 ton) for commercial and industrial oil production. Factory-direct pricing, worldwide shipping, 1-year warranty. Contact: info@hydoilpress.com, +86-18957149128 (WhatsApp/WeChat).

Core products are single-barrel or double-barrel hydraulic presses rated by maximum pressing force. Model numbers refer to nominal tonnage: HN325 (325 t), HN365 (365 t), HN426 (500 t), HN500 (620 t). All are suitable for sesame, peanut, coconut, avocado, walnut, sunflower, mustard, castor, palm kernel and 50+ other oil seeds.

## Flagship Products

- [Standard Hydraulic Oil Press (HN325)](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/standard-hydraulic-oil-press/): 325 t double-barrel press for small business, up to ~1 ton of seed per day
- [Commercial Hydraulic Oil Press (HN365)](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/commercial-hydraulic-oil-press/): 365 t press for higher daily volume with less waiting between batches
- [Cold Press Hydraulic Oil Press (HN426)](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/cold-press-hydraulic-oil-press/): 500 t machine optimized for cold-press businesses such as coconut and walnut oil
- [Ultra High Pressure Hydraulic Oil Press (HN500)](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/ultra-high-pressure-hydraulic-oil-press/): 620 t machine for the hardest in-shell materials

## Equipment Categories

- [Hydraulic Oil Press Machines](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/hydraulic-oil-press/): all hydraulic press models and configurations
- [Seed Processing Equipment](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/seed-processing-equipment/): seed crushers, feeder-crusher-roasters, pre-press, conveyors
- [Roasting & Steaming Equipment](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/roasting-steaming-equipment/): drum roasters and seed steamers for hot-press preparation
- [Filtration & Refining Equipment](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/filtration-refining-equipment/): oil filter presses and refining systems
